```{r setup, include=FALSE}
o = read.csv('orders.csv')
p = read.csv('products.csv')
op = read.csv('order_products__prior.csv')
a = read.csv('aisles.csv')

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- merge(op, o, by="order_id")
df <- merge(df, p, by="product_id")
df <- merge(df, a, by="aisle_id")
```

```{r}
tail(df)
```

```{r}
dim(df)
```

```{r}
summary(df)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(df))  
colSums(is.na(df))            
mean(is.na(df)) * 100
```

```{r}
reorder_rate <- mean(df$reordered, na.rm = TRUE)
print(round(reorder_rate * 100, 2))

mean_hour <- mean(df$order_hour_of_day, na.rm = TRUE)
print(round(mean_hour, 2))

missing_days <- sum(is.na(df$days_since_prior_order))
print(missing_days)

basket <- df %>%
  group_by(order_id) %>%
  summarize(basket_size = n()) %>%
  summarize(median_size = median(basket_size), max_size = max(basket_size))

print(basket)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = days_since_prior_order)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Days Between Orders",
       x = "Days Since Prior Order",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = order_dow)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Orders by Day of Week",
       x = "Day of Week",
       y = "Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = order_number)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Order Numbers",
       x = "Order Number",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = add_to_cart_order)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "Add to Cart Sequence",
       x = "Position in Cart",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(reordered))) +
  labs(title = "Reordered vs First-time Purchase",
       x = "Reordered",
       y = "Count") +
  geom_bar(fill = "gray") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
head(df_RFM)
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  arrange(user_id, order_number) %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  mutate(order_day = cumsum(coalesce(days_since_prior_order, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

rename(df, orderD = order_day)

max_order_number <- max(df$order_number)

rfm_data <- df %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  summarize(
    frequency = n_distinct(order_id),
    recency   = max_order_number - max(order_number),
    monetary  = n() / n_distinct(order_id),
    .groups = "drop"
    )
```

```{r}
rfm2 <- df %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  summarize(
    frequency = n_distinct(order_id),
    recency   = dplyr::last(days_since_prior_order),
    monetary  = n() / n_distinct(order_id),
    .groups = "drop")
```
